title: From the top 10 subjects with the highest number of enrolled students (cons
question: From the top 10 subjects with the highest number of enrolled students (considering only library reserve material details where the material status is 'U'), display each subject's ID, subject title, total number of enrolled students, the instructor key most frequently associated with that subject, and the count of times that instructor appears for that subject. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT d.SUBJECT_ID,
         s.SUBJECT_TITLE,
         s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS,
         d.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY
  FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL d
  JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED s
    ON d.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID
  WHERE d.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U'
),
subject_totals AS (
  SELECT SUBJECT_ID,
         SUBJECT_TITLE,
         SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled
  FROM base
  GROUP BY SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE
),
top_subjects AS (
  SELECT SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, total_enrolled
  FROM subject_totals
  ORDER BY total_enrolled DESC
  LIMIT 10
),
instructor_counts AS (
  SELECT b.SUBJECT_ID,
         b.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY,
         COUNT(*) AS instructor_count
  FROM base b
  JOIN top_subjects ts ON b.SUBJECT_ID = ts.SUBJECT_ID
  GROUP BY b.SUBJECT_ID, b.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY
),
ranked_instructors AS (
  SELECT SUBJECT_ID,
         LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY,
         instructor_count,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY instructor_count DESC, LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY) AS rn
  FROM instructor_counts
)
SELECT ts.SUBJECT_ID,
       ts.SUBJECT_TITLE,
       ts.total_enrolled,
       ri.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY,
       ri.instructor_count
FROM top_subjects ts
JOIN ranked_instructors ri ON ts.SUBJECT_ID = ri.SUBJECT_ID AND ri.rn = 1
ORDER BY ts.total_enrolled DESC

WITH DeptReservedMaterials AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department_name, COUNT(DISTINCT lrm.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS total_reserved_materials FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS tso JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` AS lrm ON td.SUBJECT_ID = lrm.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME IN ('Engineering', 'Science') AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND tso.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lrm.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) > 10), ChemistrySubjects AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_enrolled_students, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS join_dept_name FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `STUDENT_DEPARTMENT` AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 AND NOT t0.TERM_CODE IS NULL AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N') SELECT drm.department_name, drm.total_reserved_materials, cs.SUBJECT_TITLE, cs.TERM_CODE, cs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, cs.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, cs.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, cs.SCHOOL_NAME, cs.max_enrolled_students FROM DeptReservedMaterials AS drm JOIN ChemistrySubjects AS cs ON drm.department_name = cs.join_dept_name ORDER BY drm.total_reserved_materials DESC, cs.max_enrolled_students DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department_name, COUNT(DISTINCT lrm.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS total_reserved_materials FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS tso JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` AS lrm ON td.SUBJECT_ID = lrm.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME IN ('Engineering', 'Science') AND tso.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lrm.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) > 20) SELECT ic.department_name, ic.total_reserved_materials, cs.SUBJECT_TITLE, cs.TERM_CODE, cs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, cs.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, cs.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, cs.SCHOOL_NAME, cs.max_enrolled_students, ROUND(ic.total_reserved_materials / NULLIF(cs.max_enrolled_students, 0), 2) AS reserved_materials_per_max_enrollment FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_enrolled_students, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS join_dept_name FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `STUDENT_DEPARTMENT` AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 AND NOT t0.TERM_CODE IS NULL AND t0.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME IN ('Engineering', 'Science') AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N') AS cs ON ic.department_name = cs.join_dept_name ORDER BY reserved_materials_per_max_enrollment DESC

WITH enrolled_variance_cte AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, enrolled_students_variance FROM inner_cte WHERE enrolled_students_variance > (SELECT AVG(enrolled_students_variance) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC), material_count_cte AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS AS material_status_description, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count FROM `TIP_DETAIL` AS td JOIN `TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS` AS tms ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON td.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID AND td.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE (NOT td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY IS NULL AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY NOT LIKE 'N/ACourse has no materials%') GROUP BY tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(material_count) AS highest_material_count_for_status FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT evc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, evc.enrolled_students_variance, mcc.highest_material_count_for_status FROM enrolled_variance_cte AS evc LEFT JOIN material_count_cte AS mcc ON evc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mcc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY evc.enrolled_students_variance DESC

WITH academic_year_variance AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED` ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE JOIN `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` ON SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.enrolled_students_variance, LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department_name, COUNT(DISTINCT LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS total_library_subjects_offered FROM inner_cte JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED` ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE JOIN `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` ON SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.enrolled_students_variance, LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME), sponsor_type_variance AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.SPONSOR_TYPE, s.SPONSOR_NAME, s.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY, VARIANCE(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_variance FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR` AS s ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY WHERE d.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND NOT d.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NULL GROUP BY s.SPONSOR_TYPE, s.SPONSOR_NAME, s.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY) SELECT i.SPONSOR_TYPE, i.SPONSOR_NAME, i.max_enrollment_variance FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN (SELECT SPONSOR_TYPE FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR` GROUP BY SPONSOR_TYPE) AS t ON i.SPONSOR_TYPE = t.SPONSOR_TYPE) SELECT ayv.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ayv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ayv.enrolled_students_variance, ayv.department_name, ayv.total_library_subjects_offered, stv.SPONSOR_TYPE, stv.SPONSOR_NAME, stv.max_enrollment_variance FROM academic_year_variance AS ayv CROSS JOIN sponsor_type_variance AS stv ORDER BY ayv.enrolled_students_variance DESC, ayv.total_library_subjects_offered DESC, stv.max_enrollment_variance DESC

WITH material_status_stats AS (SELECT d.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, AVG(c.RECORD_COUNTER) AS avg_record_counter, VARIANCE(c.RECORD_COUNTER) AS record_counter_variance FROM `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` AS d JOIN `LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG` AS c ON d.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = c.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY WHERE c.CATALOG_YEAR > 2000 GROUP BY d.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY record_counter_variance DESC), subject_enrollment_stats AS (SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.TERM_CODE, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY lso.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_enrolled_students, lso.SUBJECT_ID FROM `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS lso INNER JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID INNER JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0) SELECT ms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, ms.avg_record_counter, ms.record_counter_variance, ses.SUBJECT_TITLE, ses.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ses.TERM_CODE, ses.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, ses.TOTAL_UNITS, ses.avg_enrolled_students FROM material_status_stats AS ms JOIN subject_enrollment_stats AS ses ON ms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = ses.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT d.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY,
         d.SUBJECT_ID,
         s.SUBJECT_TITLE,
         s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS,
         d.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY
  FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL d
  JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED s
    ON d.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = s.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
  WHERE d.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U'
),
subj AS (
  SELECT LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY,
         SUBJECT_ID,
         SUBJECT_TITLE,
         SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled
  FROM base
  GROUP BY LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE
),
top10 AS (
  SELECT * FROM subj ORDER BY total_enrolled DESC LIMIT 10
),
inst AS (
  SELECT b.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY,
         b.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY,
         COUNT(*) AS inst_count
  FROM base b
  JOIN top10 t ON b.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = t.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
  GROUP BY b.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, b.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT i.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY,
         i.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY,
         i.inst_count,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
                            ORDER BY i.inst_count DESC, i.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY) AS rn
  FROM inst i
)
SELECT t.SUBJECT_ID,
       t.SUBJECT_TITLE,
       t.total_enrolled,
       r.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY,
       r.inst_count
FROM top10 t
JOIN ranked r ON t.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = r.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY AND r.rn = 1
ORDER BY t.total_enrolled DESC

  SELECT lso.SUBJECT_ID, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS
  FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrd
  JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON lrd.SUBJECT_ID = lso.SUBJECT_ID
  JOIN LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR lci ON lrd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY
  WHERE lrd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U'
),
subject_totals AS (
  SELECT SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled
  FROM base
  GROUP BY SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE
),
top_subjects AS (
  SELECT SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, total_enrolled
  FROM subject_totals
  ORDER BY total_enrolled DESC
  LIMIT 10
),
instructor_counts AS (
  SELECT b.SUBJECT_ID, b.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, COUNT(*) AS instructor_count
  FROM base b
  JOIN top_subjects ts ON b.SUBJECT_ID = ts.SUBJECT_ID
  GROUP BY b.SUBJECT_ID, b.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY
),
ranked_instructors AS (
  SELECT SUBJECT_ID, LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, instructor_count,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY instructor_count DESC, LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY) AS rn
  FROM instructor_counts
)
SELECT ts.SUBJECT_ID, ts.SUBJECT_TITLE, ts.total_enrolled, ri.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, ri.instructor_count
FROM top_subjects ts
JOIN ranked_instructors ri ON ts.SUBJECT_ID = ri.SUBJECT_ID AND ri.rn = 1
ORDER BY ts.total_enrolled DESC
